RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the December 11, 2002/Agrahayana 20, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Coal and Mines; Defence; Home Affairs; Non-Conventional
Energy Sources; Power; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions—20

Villages in Pauri Garhwal covered
under PMGSY
*301. SHRI ROBERT KHARSHIING:
SHRI LAJP AT RAI:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of villages covered under
the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
(PMGSY) in Pauri Garhwal District of
Uttaranchal;
(b) whether Government are aware
of the fact that the population of  Thanoul
Village of Kalgikhal Block, Pauri
Garhwal do not have facility of motorable
road;
(c) whether Government had received
any representation from the people of the
area and a reference of Member of Parliament
in this regard; and
(d) the action taken to start the work of
construction of road under the Pradhan
Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana urgently and
by when the work is likely to be
completed?
Spurt in terrorist activities
*302. MAULANA OBAIDULLAH
KHAN AZMI:
SHRI SURESH P ACHOURI:
Will the Minister of HOME  AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been spurt in
terrorist activities during last one month;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the nature
of terrorist attacks;
(c) the number of paramilitary personnel,
civilians and terrorists killed and injured in
these incidents; and
(d) the steps taken to avert such incidents
in future?
Crimes committed by drug addicts
*303. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MISS. MABEL REBELLO:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether certain drug addicts used by
gangsters for committing heinous crimes
were apprehended by the Delhi Police;

and crimes committed by the drug addicts

Wind energy potential
*304. SHRI PARMESHWAR
KUMAR AGARWALLA: Will the
Minister of NON-CONVENTIONAL
ENERGY SOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India is the
fifth largest producer of wind energy in the
world;
(b) if so, the percentage of wind energy
potential being tapped in the country; and
(c) the proposals to enhance the wind
energy in the current Five Year Plan?
Vacation of quarters on transfers
*305. SHRI MUNAVVAR HASAN:
Will the Minister of COAL AND MINES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many of the
officers of Jayant and Khariya Projects of
Northern Coalfields Limited, Singrauli have
not vacated their Government quarters
despite being transferred to other places
many years ago;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that most of
the officers and employees working under
Jayant and Khariya Projects have not been
provided Government quarters so far;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) by when Government quarters are
likely to be got vacated from officers
transferred elsewhere?
New water sheds for Anantapur
District, A.P. under DDP
*306. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether any request for sanctioning
200 new watersheds projects under Desert
Development Programme (DDP) to
Anantapur district has been received in the
Ministry from the Government of Andhra
Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action taken so far or proposed to
be taken in this regard?
Fly ash from Suratgarh Super
Thermal Power Station in M.P.
†*307. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of fly ash emitted per
day and accumulated so far from Suratgarh
Super Thermal Power Station;
(b) the names of the other Thermal
Power Stations which are emitting huge
quantity of fly ash;
(c) whether Government have
formulated any scheme to make use of such
fly ash;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Presence of media during anti-terrorist
operations
*308.  SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
DR. KARAN SINGH:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the media is allowed to have
direct access at the time of anti-terrorist
operations;

93

(b) if so, upto what level of protocol or
secrecy;
(c) whether it is a fact that many intricate
details of anti-terrorist operations are likely
to be leaked out through the media; and
(d) if so, the steps Government propose
to take care of the risks involved in such
permission?
Elections to General House of SGPC
*309. SARDAR GURCHARAN
SINGH 'TOHRA':
SHRI SUKHDEV SINGH
'LIBRA':
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the elections to General
House of Shiromani Gurdwara
Prabhandhak Committee (SGPC) are due;
(b) if so, the reasons for its delay;
(c) whether the Commission responsible
to hold elections have completed all
formalities, if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) by when these elections are likely to
be held?
Modernisation of NSG
*310. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the sanctioned strength of National
Security Guards (NSG) and the number of
vacant posts as on 1st July, 2002; and
(b) what steps have been taken to
modernise the force, increase its sanctioned
strength and fill up the vacant posts, in view
of the increased role of the NSG in the
present context?
Prosecution of criminals
*311.  SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
a proposal for the formation of a
Coordination Committee to prosecute
criminals  effectively and to ensure that
witnesses are not bought over by criminals;
(b) if so, the details of the proposal with
regard to composition of the said Committee;
and
(c) whether the Coordination Committee
will be headed by a prominent Judge and
if not, the reasons therefor?
Projects for rural drinking water
supply in Andhra Pradesh
*312. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the present status of pilot projects of
Rural Water Supply Programme in Chittoor,
Khammam, Nalgonda, Nellore, Prakasam
districts of Andhra Pradesh under rural
drinking water component of Prime
Minister's Gramodaya Yojana (PMGY);
(b) by when these projects are likely to
be completed;
(c) whether more districts are proposed
to be covered under PMGY; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Distribution and transmission losses

SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:

(a) whether it is a fact that power shortage
in peak as well as general hours in the country
can be brought to negligible level by bringing
the losses in its distribution and transmission
system at the international  level;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that the
power distribution and transmission losses
at international level have been assessed at
six per cent only; and

Statehood to Delhi
*314. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR REDDY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether as on date Delhi has the
status of a State of the Indian Union;
(b) if not, whether Government propose
to confer Statehood to Delhi in the near
future;
(c) if so, by when; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Royalty rate on coal production
*315.  SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of COAL AND
MINES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have accepted
the proposal for a new royalty rate on coal
production;
(b) if so, to what extent the rate will be
increased;
(c) whether the consumer States had
opposed the increase;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(e) whether with the projected increase
in coal production from the current level of
310 million tonnes per annum to 400 million
tonnes by the end of the Tenth Five Year
Plan, the States are expected to gain from
the royalty rates increase?
Conflicts between Bodos and Non-
Bodos in Assam
*316. SHRI DRUPAD BORGOHAIN:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the new conflicts between Bodos and Non-
Bodos in the proposed BTC Areas of
Assam;
(b) whether any policy has been
formulated to solve this problem; and
(c) the steps taken or proposed to be
taken to deal with the extremists forces of
this region?
Construction of small hydro-power
projects
†*317. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
 SHRI RAJIV RANJAN
SINGH 'LALAN':
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are
contemplating to give incentives for the
construction of the hydro power projects
producing 50 to 75 megawatt of electricity ;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) whether it is a fact that small power
projects in the country are more beneficial
than the big power projects?

pleased to state:

Compulsory Territorial Army Service
for new entrants
*319. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the proposal to make two
months Territor ial Army Service
compulsory for all new Government service
entrants has been finalized; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when
this scheme is going to be implemented?
Defence production by HAL
*320. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Hindustan
Aeronautics Limited (HAL), despite keen
interest from abroad on its products like the
Advanced light Helicopter (ALH), is not
able to cope up with mass production or
series production of India's indigenous aero
products;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the fresh steps taken by the
Government to involve private companies'
consortiums for mass production of these
products and to enter export  markets for
products like ALH and LCA?
